name: Shading for Semi-Transparent Volumes
aliases: Local diffuse illumination for semi-transparent volumes
Semi-transparent volume shading with local diffuse illumination
definition: A technique to enable shading for semi-transparent volume rendering using multi-stage rasterization hardware, allowing per-voxel ambient color specification at the cost of real trilinear interpolation.
summary: Shading for Semi-Transparent Volumes is a single-pass technique using register combiners to compute local diffuse illumination via dot products, distinguishing itself by avoiding frame buffer copies and alpha-testing.
